content.short: Swap, bridge & trade between Cardano-based tokens and stablecoins within seconds.
content.description:
AdaSwap is an AMM (Automated Market Maker) platform that provides decentralized and noncustodial market-making for liquidity providers, built and utilized on top of the Cardano blockchain infrastructure. The algorithmic protocol compiles a comprehensive logic that is derived of built-in liquidity provision, DAO, and NFT marketplace smart-contract characteristics.

We are striving to be the first DEX based on Cardano! Our main goal is to develop tools for creators and users, as well as bringing high-yield staking pools and NFT content through our launchpads and marketplaces.
